sloka: दिदृक्षमाणो वैदेहीम् हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ।स ददर्शाविदूरस्था राक्षसीर्घोरदर्शनाः ।। ५-१७-४।।
transliteration: didṛkṣamāṇo vaidehīm hanumān mārutātmajaḥ ।sa dadarśāvidūrasthā rākṣasīrghoradarśanāḥ ।। 5-17-4।।

translations.english: While Hanuman was eager to observe Sita he saw many shedemons in ugly appearance close by her. One of them was oneeyed, another with a single ear, a third had ears covering the body, yet another had pointed (spikelike) ears, one was breathing through the nose on the head, one had long thin neck, one was hairless another had hair covering like a blanket. One of them had hanging ears on the forehead, another had big hanging lips, still another had long lips hanging up to the chin. So also one had protruding knees, one stunted, one tall, another had lips extending up to her chin, yet another was longfaced and another had long knees. There was one pigmy, one tall, one was humpbacked and another a dwarf.Similarly an ugly looking one, another with gaping mouth, still another with a distorted face, one with yellow eyes and one of deformed face were seen.
translations.hindi: जानकी को देखते-देखते पवननन्दन हनुमानजी की दृष्टि उन भयङ्कर रूपों वाली राक्षसियों पर पड़ी जो सीताजी के समीप ही बैठी हुई थीं
